summary: Entegris filed an 8-K announcing a quarterly cash dividend of $0.10 per share, declared by its board on July 15, 2026. The dividend is payable on August 19, 2026, to shareholders of record as of July 29, 2026. This represents a routine capital return to shareholders, with no special premium, tender, or restructuring involved. The filing serves as a standard dividend declaration without structural complexities or advisors mentioned. What to watch: consistency of future dividends given semiconductor industry cyclicality.
